newsitem.title: UK: Bank J Vontobel sets warrants on five indices.
newsitem.headline: Bank J Vontobel sets warrants on five indices.

text.p: Bank J Vontobel & Co AG says it has issued two million call and put warrants, in two equal tranches, on the five SPI sector indices "Banks', "Chemistry and Pharmceuticals', "Food', "Insurance' and "Machinery'.

The exercise period is from December 18, 1996 to December 18, 1997 during which 50 warrants entitle to a cash payment of the difference, by which the closing price of the corresponding SPI subindex on the exercise day exceeds or is below the exercise price.
One point in the indices corresponds to 1.00 Sfr.
The listing of the options on the Swiss stock exchange ill be applied. Settlement day for all issues in December 18, 1996.
